$comment: Single source for per-client install kind, hook coverage and setup steps. Edit here, then run: npm --prefix server run generate:client-matrix. Generated into README.md and docs/reference/client-capabilities.md.

clients.name: Claude Code
clients.hooksNote: Hooks ship in this repo's plugin.

clients.name: Codex
clients.hooksNote: Codex hooks are off by default and need a one-time `/hooks` trust review. Requires Codex CLI 0.117 or later; unavailable on Windows.

clients.name: Claude Desktop
steps: **Option A: GitHub Release** (recommended): download `claude-prompts-{version}.mcpb` from [Releases](https://github.com/minipuft/claude-prompts-mcp/releases/latest) and drag it into Claude Desktop Settings → MCP Servers. The `.mcpb` bundle is self-contained (~5MB); no npm required.
**Option B: NPX** (auto-updates): add this to your config file (macOS: `~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json`, Windows: `%APPDATA%\Claude\claude_desktop_config.json`):
Restart Claude Desktop and test: `>>research_chain topic:'remote team policies'`

clients.name: OpenCode
steps: For MCP tools without hooks, use the manual config in the [Client Integration Guide](docs/guides/client-integration.md).

clients.name: Gemini CLI
steps: For MCP tools without hooks, use the manual config in the [Client Integration Guide](docs/guides/client-integration.md).

clients.name: Cursor
steps: Add the server to `~/.cursor/mcp.json`. The [Client Integration Guide](docs/guides/client-integration.md) has the JSON example and the `--client` preset.

clients.name: VS Code
steps: Add the server through VS Code's MCP configuration. The [Client Integration Guide](docs/guides/client-integration.md) has the JSON example and the `--client` preset.

clients.name: Windsurf
steps: Add the server to `~/.codeium/windsurf/mcp_config.json`. The [Client Integration Guide](docs/guides/client-integration.md) has the JSON example and the `--client` preset.

clients.name: Zed
steps: Add the server under the `mcp` key of `~/.config/zed/settings.json`. The [Client Integration Guide](docs/guides/client-integration.md) has the JSON example and the `--client` preset.
